# Pinned Slimeskull sources

These JSON/Java files are unchanged from Tinkers' Construct revision
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

The manifest records source paths and SHA-256 hashes. Tool context/material
predicate fixtures are retained in the sibling `modified_tool` and
`material_master` folders. The native goal adapts the icon key and omits the
icon's unsupported source NBT; all criterion predicates remain unchanged.
